It may lead to confusion for future maintainers and could result in incorrect usage of these methods.

These methods convert the state to an intermediate block format but do not log or emit any metrics about this process. Without observability into these critical operations, it is difficult to trace issues related to state conversion and identify performance bottlenecks. This lack of logging can make debugging and monitoring challenging.

- Technical Cause: Missing writer method for EnrichExec in the technical mapping.
